insights.diagram: Every token here is a unit of cognition — this diagram is the economy; the rest of the page is its measurements.
insights.flows: Outflow is the signal: ~$1,899/day of distribution IS the ecosystem's activity. Inflow is manual treasury logistics keeping the wallet alive — 14% of lifetime inflow is usage fees recycling back.
insights.daily: Watch the pulse, not the balance: distribution spikes mark campaigns and growth pushes; the current pace is ~$1,899/day.
insights.cognition: 67% of everything ever distributed has been spent on real cognition — demand matches supply; this is the number that makes every other number mean something.
insights.recipients: 10,000+ wallets hold verifiable on-chain earnings history — the property layer. (This table counts only transfers FROM this treasury wallet.)
insights.sources: All inflow is deliberate ops — treasury refills and collector recycling. Every source wallet should carry a label; unlabeled = ask treasury ops.
insights.server: The off-chain shadow (Stripe checkout events only): where it disagrees with the chain is exactly where our data gaps live — revenue figures are floors until the Stripe export lands.
insights.aizone: Best-guess triage, never fact: distribution is mostly invoke-sized, ~17.2 days of float at current pace, and $367.76 (1.1% of creator earnings) looks unusual — nothing confirmed.
